[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai ke paas toh aadha Gurgaon hai ab, lifestyle dekho
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, chhota sa kaam. ek dost ke liye puchh raha hoon — tumhari company mein koi opening hai? operations ya general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket chalega.
Sameer: woh isi mahine move karna chah raha hai. solid banda hai, saalon apna setup chalaya hai.
Sameer: aur yaar group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab.
Faisal: arre haan haan pakka, Monday ko HR se puchhta hoon 👍
---
[College group, agle din, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion ka venue toh set hai phir — Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, teen din baad]
Faisal: bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Sameer ke DM mein "dost" kaun hai aur tumhe kaise pata? Third-person wala frame Sameer ke liye kya kaam kar raha hai — yahi costume kyun?
2. Agle din Faisal ke group message ne Sameer ke saath kya kiya, trace karo. DM chup kyun ho gaya — thumbs-up, joke, aur teen din ki silence ko jodo.
3. Woh DM likho jo Faisal ko ab bhejna chahiye, bilkul waisa jaisa bhejna chahiye — jo Sameer ko asli help dilaye bina usse kuch bhi admit karwaye.

# 1. "Dost" kaun hai — aur costume kyun kaam kar raha hai

**"Dost" Sameer khud hai.** Clues:

- **Timing:** 9:14 pm pe group mein flex (Dubai pool, "aadha Gurgaon", "expanding soon 😎") — aur do ghante baad hi DM mein "dost" ke liye 15-18 LPA ki job maang raha hai. Jo banda apna setup chala raha hai, usse job kyun chahiye?
- **Detail ka level:** "saalon apna setup chalaya hai" — yeh resume pitch hai, dost ka intro nahi. Aur "isi mahine move karna chah raha hai" = urgency jo sirf khud ke liye hoti hai.
- **Salary bracket khud batayi:** Dost ke liye puchh rahe ho toh tum "15-18 LPA chalega?" nahi bolte — woh dost batata.
- **"Group mein zikr mat karna":** Asli reason yeh hai — Sameer ko nahi chahta ki Faisal ko ya kisi ko pata chale ki *usko* job chahiye, kyunki group mein toh woh "expanding soon boys" wala banda hai.

**Costume kyun kaam kar raha hai:** Third-person frame Sameer ko teen cheezein deta hai — (a) ego protection: rejection "dost" ki hoti hai, uski nahi; (b) negotiation space: "dost" flexible hai, salary pe baat ho sakti hai bina embarrassment ke; (c) deniability: agar Faisal kabhi expose kare, Sameer bol sakta hai "main toh bas beech ka aadmi tha." Yeh ek classic face-saving device hai — flex aur need dono ko ek hi raat mein jee lene deta hai.

# 2. Faisal ke group message ne kya kiya — trace

Sequence dekho:

1. **DM mein Sameer ne explicitly bola:** "group mein iska zikr mat karna, woh private rakhta hai yeh sab."
2. **Agle din Faisal group mein likhta hai:** "Sameer bhai sponsor karenge, business boom kar raha hai 😂"

Faisal ne directly job ka zikr nahi kiya — lekin usne Sameer ke public persona ko amplify kar diya ("business boom"). Ab Sameer ke paas trap hai:
- Agar woh ab Faisal se DM mein CV maange/forward kare, toh risk hai ki "boom kar raha hai business" wale bande ka CV HR ke paas pahunche — aur Faisal connect kar le.
- Thumbs-up (👍) isliye — minimal response, joke mein shamil hua par kuch add nahi kiya. Flex narrative ko fuel diya taaki "business booming" image strong bane.

3. **Phir jab Faisal DM mein CV maangta hai** — "bhai, HR ne dost ka CV manga hai, bhej doge? hello? bhai?" — Sameer chup hai. Kyunki:
   - CV bhejna = "dost" ka naam, number, history Faisal ke haath mein = mask girne ka risk.
   - CV na bhejna = "dost" ka excuse tootna.
   - Toh silence hi safest move hai. Teen din ki silence cost hai jo Sameer pay karne ko tayyar hai — kyunki "dost" ka exposure uske liye "business booming" image se zyada mehnga hai.

**Short version:** Faisal ka innocent joke ne Sameer ke do narratives ko aapas mein takra diya — aur Sameer ne choose kiya ki flex bachega, help nahi.

# 3. Faisal ka ideal DM

Jo na kuch admit karwaye, na pressure dikhaye, par door khula rakhe:

> "Bhai, woh banda last week se busy chal raha hai, isliye reply nahi aa paya hoga. Ek baat — agar role genuinely achhi hai toh HR ko bol de ki position open rakhe agle hafte tak, main personally follow-up karunga usse. Waise bhi reunion mein sab milenge, wahan bhi baat ho jayegi. Tu bas HR wali side tight kar de 👍"

**Yeh kyun kaam karta hai:**
- **"Busy chal raha hai"** — Sameer ko face-saving exit deta hai bina yeh bole ki woh dodge kar raha hai.
- **"Main personally follow-up karunga"** — responsibility Faisal pe shift ho gayi, Sameer pe pressure nahi; aur Sameer ko ek graceful re-entry window milta hai.
- **Deadline (agle hafte) + reunion mention** — urgency create karti hai bina accusation ke, aur reunion ek natural, public-safe meeting point hai jahan Sameer bina DM-exposure ke engage kar sakta hai.
- **Kahin bhi yeh nahi:** "tumne kaha tha," "kyun silent ho," "dost ka sach kya hai." Faisal ko lagta hai woh bas ek helpful recruiter friend hai — jabki asli game woh khel raha hai: Sameer ko ek aisa rasta dena jismein woh help le sake apni image jalaye bina.
